observation: Launch order rows wrap badly: 'max 20 s (default)' breaks into 'max 20 / s / (de- / fault)', steppers crowd 'then 0 s'; rows are tall and ragged.
suggested_fix: Stack the row in two lines (Wait for picker; then delay and max timeout each with label+stepper), shorten '(default)' to a placeholder, use fixedSize/lineLimit(1).

observation: View mode: 'Set shortcut' is disabled and low-contrast monospaced with no explanation; unlike other buttons it looks like a different font/style.
suggested_fix: Use the same button style and font; add .help explaining why disabled and how to enable; hide when not applicable.

observation: View vs Edit is a segmented control, but nothing says that changes are made only in Edit; 'Compare', 'Sync', 'Preview restore', 'Run' are unexplained and Sync appears twice in two modes. Top-bar has five distinct controls with equal weight; Run (primary) is not emphasised.
suggested_fix: Make Run the prominent accent button; add tooltips for Compare/Sync (what is compared with what); group secondary actions in a menu.

observation: Window tiles overlap: a Finder tile stack shows x4 with offset ghost cards, and Windows Here lists 4 windows but only Finder is visible; large empty desktop frame with tiles clumped in the corner (positions not scaled to monitor).
suggested_fix: Scale tiles to saved window frames; show stack count tooltip; ensure the stack is clearly one of many (click to expand).

observation: Built-in Retina Display frame is entirely empty with no label like 'No windows on this monitor' and no hint; also the monitor header text is tiny and bold at low contrast.
suggested_fix: Add empty text 'No windows on this display' and a prominent monitor name/size; dim empty desktops consistently.

observation: Tile labels in canvas render as garbled overlapping text ('SafariEdit' / 'TextEdit' drawn on top of each other) in the stacked 3-window tile.
suggested_fix: Show only the top window name plus '+2' badge in a stack, or clip/truncate; avoid drawing all labels.

observation: Options is a long scrolling form; section 'Stage Manager' is cut at the bottom with no scroll hint; toggles are low contrast when off (Add missing Desktops looks nearly invisible vs on).
suggested_fix: Add a fade/scroll indicator, strengthen off-state of toggles, consider collapsing rarely used sections.

observation: 'Restore Desktop order' warns about a 'guarded repair' that 'can briefly flicker' but the term is not explained and the toggle is on by default; 'What to do with other apps: Leave' is vague and the chevron value is small.
suggested_fix: Explain in plain words ('may move Desktops around; asks to confirm'); default off or add a Learn more link; use label 'Other apps: Leave alone / Hide / Quit' with descriptions.

observation: Edit toolbar mixes text buttons and ~9 unlabeled icons (grid, snap, link, lock, wand, stack) with no tooltips visible; icons are ambiguous.
suggested_fix: Add .help and accessibilityLabel to each icon; group with dividers and labels; show keyboard shortcuts.

observation: Edit header has Cancel and Save side by side; 'Cancel' with unsaved edits and no visible dirty indicator ('No problems' reads as validation not as changed state). Live toggle is unexplained.
suggested_fix: Show 'Unsaved changes' dot; Cancel asks to discard; explain Live with tooltip; show problems text with count and click to jump.

observation: Empty state offers only Capture, but window is fully blank (sidebar hidden, no toolbar), so the app gives no other path (create blank profile, import, read guide); button is low contrast gray; capture sheet says nothing about Accessibility permission need.
suggested_fix: Add secondary 'Create blank profile' and 'Open guide'; make Capture the accent prominent button; check permission and warn inline.

observation: Left rail has colored icons (teal monitor, red eye, green layout, purple pencil) with no labels or tooltips; the red eye reads as warning/error and the active profile is unclear; the plus sits above without text.
suggested_fix: Add profile names in tooltips or expand rail; use neutral color for the selected state and reserve red for errors; add accessibility labels.

observation: Preview restore sheet: 'Run now' is gray (looks disabled) while Close is equally weighted; 'Not found (3)' repeats the same info as launch list and says 'not found' for apps that will simply launch (warning icon wrongly signals a problem). Large empty space in the sheet.
suggested_fix: Make Run now the default accent button (Return); rename section 'Will be launched' with neutral icon; merge duplicate lists; size sheet to content; show what moves (windows/desktops) not only launches.

observation: Sheet is not clearly modal: content behind dimmed but header/toolbar partially visible and sheet edge overlaps the canvas; the 'Refresh' button style differs from other buttons; no ESC/Cmd+W hint.
suggested_fix: Use standard sheet presentation with fixed size, keyboard shortcuts (Esc closes, Return runs).

observation: The capture-sheet.png is identical to the inspector screenshot (no capture sheet visible), so capture selection flow could not be reviewed; the capture route hook appears broken.
suggested_fix: Fix the UX test hook for sheet=capture and re-shoot; then review the capture selection sheet.

observation: Footer legend text is small and low contrast; 'Debug log' toggle sits in the user-facing footer; zoom '100% Fit' lacks separation from the nav arrows (arrows only in view mode).
suggested_fix: Move Debug log to Settings/debug menu; raise legend contrast; keep the zoom cluster stable between modes.

observation: Sequential/At once picker and the up/down arrows in the same row are unrelated (arrows move rows but are disabled with no selected row); 'Worst case: 20 s' is cryptic and the footnotes are cut tight at the bottom edge.
suggested_fix: Separate mode picker from reorder controls (use drag handles); rename to 'Longest wait: 20 s'; add padding below footnotes.

observation: Inspector placeholder text 'Select a window on the map to see its details' sits far from the top and the right collapse chevron floats mid-edge with no label; Inspector tabs missing in View mode while present in Edit mode (inconsistent layout).
suggested_fix: Use consistent panel chrome in both modes; label collapse control with tooltip.
